name: Daeska Sol
description: A cyclops berserker who fought beside Baas, escaped arrest at Tin Street Market and did not wait for her.

timeline.summary: Baas reveals she was arrested at Tin Street Market and abandoned by Daeska, and why she avoids the front line.
timeline.quote: I got arrested. Daeska got away.

relations.note: Daeska was her partner but did not wait for her.
relations.quote: Turns out, I got released early, only to find out that tramp hadn't even waited ten months.
